submitter: bugs_open/257 lane. A peer session (copy_quality_two_stage) reported a latent 400 on the token-budget contract this lane owns; they hit it first-hand four times. Verified independently before acting, and the verification CHANGED the fix: the rule is not blanket.
rationale:
A LATENT 400, ON A CONTRACT THIS LANE WIDENED THIS MORNING.

platform/aiservice/anthropic.go:278-296 emits thinking: {"type":"enabled","budget_tokens":N} whenever options["budget_tokens"] resolves to a positive number. ai_actions.go:420 sets that option from ResolveStepBudget - code this lane committed today (d88afbf84). Anthropic replaced the fixed thinking budget with adaptive thinking, and that request shape is now REJECTED WITH A 400 on the Claude 5 family and Opus 4.7/4.8. A peer lane hit it four times replaying a stored writer prompt against claude-sonnet-5.

WHY THIS IS THIS LANE'S. Round 3 widened where budget_tokens may be declared from TWO places to SIX - the ladder reads the bare spelling at every level. The surface grew this morning while the exposure stayed zero, so the trap this arms is one this lane built.

VERIFIED, NOT ACCEPTED - AND THE VERIFICATION CHANGED THE DESIGN. The peer's framing was "Sonnet 5, Opus 5 and the 4.7/4.8 family". Checked against the authoritative model reference, there are THREE live answers, not two:
  claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-4-8      REJECTED - 400 on every call
  claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6    deprecated but FUNCTIONAL (transitional escape hatch)
  claude-haiku-4-5 and older            REQUIRED - thinking does not happen without it
[MEASURED 2026-09-04, live agent_definitions] those map to 88 of 176 model declarations across 22 agents on the rejecting side (claude-sonnet-5 87/21, claude-opus-4-8 1/1), 53 declarations across 36 agents on the deprecated-but-working side, and 32 across 24 agents where the key is REQUIRED. So a guard that simply stopped sending the key would take extended thinking away from the only models where it still works. That is why this ships as a model-aware predicate and a report, not as a change to the reader.

LIVE EXPOSURE IS ZERO, CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT ENCODINGS. jsonb_path_exists(default_config,'strict $.**.budget_tokens') (the peer's form) and a recursive jsonb walk (this lane's) both return 0 - zero of 208 active rows, zero of all 225 rows including snapshots and deleted. Four rows match the STRING; all four are a reviewer seat's footprint keyword list, not a declaration. A substring census over config text reads as three live agents and means none - worth stating because that is the number a reasonable reader would have reported.

SO THIS IS A GUARD, NOT A CLEANUP. There is nothing to repair today. The failure fires on the first operator to declare the key; it takes down every call for that step, not one; it is invisible until then; and the declaration is a one-word config change that looks obviously safe.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT DECIDED HERE. Whether the provider client should refuse, drop-with-warning, or keep returning the 400 is a behaviour change on a shared seam and is left open. Dropping silently would be THIS BUG'S OWN DEFECT CLASS - a configured key that nothing reads - and the 400 is at least loud. The predicate is written so that decision can be made later without a second model list.

plan.summary: Add a model-aware AcceptsThinkingBudget predicate to the file that already owns model-version knowledge, a build-time parity test so a new alias cannot default silently to the unsafe answer, and a thinking_unsupported arm in the budget-placement report that fails the run on a budget_tokens declaration against a rejecting model. Zero behaviour change: no request is altered and the provider client is untouched.

edits.rationale: The predicate belongs beside the alias table, whose own header says 'Update this file when Anthropic releases new model versions' - one place to maintain, reachable by both the audit and (later) the client without a second list. An UNKNOWN model returns true, the historical behaviour, because this predicate must never be the reason a working call stops being made. The second map is not consulted at runtime: it exists so the parity test can tell 'considered and accepts' from 'nobody has looked at this model'.
edits.sketch:
+
+
+var modelsRejectingThinkingBudget = map[string]bool{
+	"claude-fable-5":    true,
+	"claude-fable-5-1":  true,
+	"claude-mythos-5":   true,
+	"claude-mythos-5-1": true,
+	"claude-opus-5":     true,
+	"claude-opus-4-8":   true,
+	"claude-opus-4-7":   true,
+	"claude-sonnet-5":   true,
+}
+
+var modelsAcceptingThinkingBudget = map[string]bool{
+	"claude-sonnet-4-6": true,
+	"claude-opus-4-6":   true,
+	"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929": true,
+	"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001":  true,
+	"claude-opus-4-5-20251101":   true,
+	"claude-sonnet-4-20250514":   true,
+	"claude-opus-4-20250514":     true,
+	"claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022": true,
+	"claude-3-5-haiku-20241022":  true,
+	"claude-3-opus-20240229":     true,
+	"claude-3-sonnet-20240229":   true,
+	"claude-3-haiku-20240307":    true,
+}
+
+func AcceptsThinkingBudget(model string) bool {
+	return !modelsRejectingThinkingBudget[ResolveModelAlias(model, nil)]
+}
+
+func KnownModelAliases() []string {
+	out := make([]string, 0, len(ModelAliases))
+	for alias := range ModelAliases {
+		out = append(out, alias)
+	}
+	return out
+}

edits.rationale: A new model id added to ModelAliases and not classified defaults to 'accepts', the UNSAFE direction - it would let a declaration through to a model that 400s every call. The parity test fails the build on any alias in neither map, and refuses to pass over an empty alias table. The second test pins all three live answers by name, including that an unrecognised model stays permissive.

Converts 'invisible until the first operator declares it' into 'caught by a report that already runs'. Checked BEFORE the max_tokens arms because it is not a sizing question - it is a request the provider refuses. The model is resolved by the SAME overlay order production uses (step ai_service over root ai_service), so a step declaring no model of its own is judged against the agent's, which is most steps; getting that wrong would silently exempt them. Fails the run alongside unconfigured and ambiguous; non_canonical stays the only advisory kind.

LIVE EXPOSURE IS ZERO, so these tests ARE the exercise - without them the arm would ship never having fired, which is the dormant-machinery shape this estate has been bitten by. The accepting-model case matters most: claude-haiku-4-5 carries 32 declarations across 24 live agents and REQUIRES the key, so flagging it would be telling operators to break the only models where it works.

Prints the new kind first and states the non-blanket rule in its header, so an operator reading the report is not told to delete a key that is REQUIRED on their model. Exit semantics otherwise unchanged.

grounded_in: platform/aiservice/anthropic.go:278-296 - the thinking block is emitted on the PRESENCE of a positive budget_tokens, building exactly the request shape that now returns 400.

platform/orchestration/actions/ai_actions.go:420 - ResolveStepBudget("budget_tokens", ...), this lane's own code committed 2026-09-04, and the reason the declaration surface went from two places to six.

platform/aiservice/anthropic.go:300-303 - 'Temperature is intentionally NOT sent to Anthropic. Claude Opus 4.7+ returns a 400 for any non-default temperature, and extended thinking is incompatible with temperature on any model.' The file already carries one model-version constraint of exactly this shape, three lines below the block being guarded.

platform/aiservice/model_aliases.go header - 'Update this file when Anthropic releases new model versions.' The predicate is placed against that stated maintenance contract rather than beside its consumer.
